thread.title: Dow Jumps 234 Points Because the Trade War Is Bigger Than Apple

author: Barron's
title: Dow Jumps 234 Points Because the Trade War Is Bigger Than Apple
text:
Michael Haddad 6:27 a.m. Apple ( AAPL ) is down more than 5%, but sometimes the market is bigger than its biggest stock.
That's the case this morning as S&P4 500 futures have risen 0.8%, while Dow Jones Industrial Average futures have gained 234 points, or 0.9%. Nasdaq Composite futures have advanced 0.2%.
Apple's earnings had caused the major indexes to drop into the red immediately following its release, but investors have chosen to focus instead on reports that U.S. President Donald Trump has requested his advisors write up a trade deal with China .
As big a drag as Apple is, the trade war has been a bigger one . If it really does come to something resembling an end, today's rally might only be the beginning.
